content: buf generate reads buf.gen.yaml listing plugins+output dirs (e.g. buf.build/protocolbuffers/go and buf.build/connectrpc/go -> gen/go; a TS/connect-es plugin -> gen/ts). Common pattern: one buf.gen.yaml with multiple plugin blocks (or split buf.gen.go.yaml / buf.gen.ts.yaml) run from a single proto/ source tree, output committed under gen/go and gen/ts (or generated in CI). Managed mode in buf.gen.yaml sets go_package/language options centrally so .proto files stay language-neutral.
